definition.def: To create something means to cause it to happen or exist.
examples: We set business free to create more jobs in Britain. [VERB noun]
She could create a fight out of anything. [VERB noun]
The lights create such a glare it's next to impossible to see anything behind them. [VERB noun]
Criticizing will only destroy a relationship and create feelings of failure. [VERB noun]

definition.def: When someone creates a new product or process, they invent it or design it.
examples: It is really great for a radio producer to create a show like this. [VERB noun]
He's creating a whole new language of painting. [VERB noun]
